=== Recipes ===
Vision Crystals are used in crafting weapons for [[artificer]], [[huntsman]], and [[weaponsmith]]:
* [[Vision Crystal/Artificer|Artificer recipes]]
* [[Vision Crystal/Huntsman|Huntsman recipes]]
* [[Vision Crystal/Weaponsmith|Weaponsmith recipes]]

And chest armor for [[armorsmith]], [[leatherworker]], and [[tailor]]:
* [[Vision Crystal/Armorsmith|Armorsmith recipes]]
* [[Vision Crystal/Leatherworker|Leatherworker recipes]]
* [[Vision Crystal/Tailor|Tailor recipes]]

It is also needed to craft [[component]]s for some [[precursor]]s:
{{Recipe table|ingredient=Vision Crystal|type=Legendary Component}}

As well as various [[backpack]]s:
{{Recipe table|ingredient=Vision Crystal|type=Backpack}}

==== {{handiworker}} Handiworker ====
{{Recipe list|discipline=Handiworker}}

==== Other ====
For crafting [[Stellar weapons]], a Vision Crystal is needed to create an [[Irradiated Vision Crystal]] at the [[Beam of Light]] in [[The Astralarium]].
{{Recipe table|ingredient=Vision Crystal|source=Other}}

=== Achievements ===
A Vision Crystal is also used to accomplish certain achievements:
* [[Knight of the Thorn]]
* [[A Henge Away from Home]]
* [[Lost Pilgrims]]: Can be brought in your inventory instead of finding the [[Vision Crystal (bundle)|open world Vision Crystal bundle]], will not be consumed.
* [[All or Nothing (achievements)#Chasing Tales|Chasing Tales]] (used at the [[Heroic Font]] to complete the achievement, is consumed)

== Trivia ==
* In the original Guild Wars, the [[gw1:Vision Crystal|Vision Crystal]] was an artifact used in a series of missions that had to be completed in order to [[gw1:Ascend|ascend]].
